description: This Java class 'DateUtil' provides utility methods for date formatting, parsing, and manipulation, including generating timestamps, formatting dates in various formats, adding days to current date, and processing posted date parameters from HTTP requests.

classes.name: DateUtil
classes.description: Utility class for date formatting, parsing, and manipulation.

methods.name: generateTimeStamp
methods.description: Generates a timestamp string in 'yyyyMMddHHmmSS' format.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string using default date format.

methods.name: formatYear
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string representing the year.

methods.name: formatLongDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a long date string with day, date, month, year, time, and timezone.

methods.name: formatDateMonthString
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string with pattern 'yyyy-MM-dd'.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Parses a date string into a Date object using default date format.

methods.name: addDaysToCurrentDate
methods.description: Returns a Date object representing the current date plus a specified number of days.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the current date and time.

methods.name: getPresentDate
methods.description: Returns the current date formatted as a string.

methods.name: getPresentYear
methods.description: Returns the current year as a string.

methods.name: processPostedDates
methods.description: Processes 'startdate' and 'enddate' parameters from an HTTP request and sets internal startDate and endDate.
